We’re celebrating National Park Week with a deep dive into Olympic National Park in Washington State. Join us as an official U.S. Park Ranger answers top-trending searches around National Parks and the great outdoors. We’ll explore tidepools, rainforests and glacial mountain ranges, looking out for the special flora and fauna that make the Olympics so unique. Put on your hiking boots, it’s the next episode of Searching For.
